split_method: random permutation of unique claim ids
cross_validation: not used for initial comparison; any future folds stay inside training
validation_use: select predeclared models using validation MAE in original loss units
test_use: reserved for one November final evaluation; test targets and scores remain unused during October
stopping_rule: stop the initial comparison after all predeclared candidates are evaluated; do not seed-hunt
split_change_rule: change only for documented ID, overlap, omission, or partition-integrity failure
